items.title: Wall Street's flip from AI to less-loved stocks accelerates, while oil prices keep easing
items.summary: Oil prices, meanwhile, eased further from the two-month high  they hit last week.  The S&P 500 added 0.2%, but the modest move masked big swings underneath the surface.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 537 points, or 1%, while the Nasdaq composite slipped 0.2% after briefly dropping 9.3% below its record set last month.
